verdict.rationale: User roles and permissions are a fair question for a business finance account, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document team-member roles, permission levels, or location or department scoping. The only related items are card-level spending permissions and MCC/currency spend rules, which are adjacent card controls rather than user role management and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can define granular user roles and permissions across team members, locations, and departments
